description: Defines the Pickler class responsible for serializing TorchScript objects, including methods for pushing various data types and managing serialization state.

classes.name: Pickler
classes.description: A class for serializing TorchScript objects into a binary format, supporting various data types and managing internal serialization state.

methods.name: Pickler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Pickler with a writer function and optional parameters for tensor table, type renamer, class types, tensor ID function, and tag aggregation.

methods.name: ~Pickler
methods.description: Destructor for the Pickler class.

methods.name: protocol
methods.description: Push protocol onto the serialization stack.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Push STOP opcode onto the serialization stack.

methods.name: pushIValue
methods.description: Serialize an IValue object.

methods.name: startTuple
methods.description: Begin serializing a tuple.

methods.name: endTuple
methods.description: End serializing a tuple.

methods.name: pushEmptyDict
methods.description: Serialize an empty dictionary.

methods.name: pushDict
methods.description: Serialize a dictionary from an IValue.

methods.name: pushInt
methods.description: Serialize an integer value.

methods.name: pushLong
methods.description: Serialize a long integer as string data.

methods.name: pushString
methods.description: Serialize a string.

methods.name: pushDevice
methods.description: Serialize device information from an IValue.

methods.name: pushTensor
methods.description: Serialize a tensor from an IValue.

methods.name: pushTensorReference
methods.description: Serialize a tensor reference from an IValue.

methods.name: pushLiteralTensor
methods.description: Serialize a literal tensor.

methods.name: pushLiteralSparseTensor
methods.description: Serialize a sparse tensor.

methods.name: pushTuple
methods.description: Serialize a tuple from an IValue.

methods.name: pushStringImpl
methods.description: Serialize a string without additional metadata.

methods.name: pushStorageOfTensor
methods.description: Serialize tensor storage data.

methods.name: pushBinGet
methods.description: Add a BINPUT opcode and return its ID.

methods.name: pushSpecializedList
methods.description: Serialize a specialized list with a custom item pusher.

methods.name: pushGlobal
methods.description: Serialize global module and class names.

methods.name: pushBytes
methods.description: Append raw string data to the byte stream.

methods.name: pushTensorData
methods.description: Serialize tensor data.

methods.name: pushNextBinPut
methods.description: Add a BINPUT opcode and get its ID.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Get a raw pointer to an IValue.
